install_msg: Thank you for installing SINWallGuard. Use [p]load sinwallguard, then [p]sinwallguard meme #memes for the recommended meme-channel setup. Use [p]slash sync after loading if you want slash commands immediately.
name: SINWallGuard
short: SIN Corp wall-of-text containment for meme channels.
description: Per-channel word and character limits with SIN Corp lore warnings, strike tracking, and optional short timeouts on repeated violations. Includes hybrid slash/prefix commands.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server channel settings persistently. It does not persistently store end-user message contents or user strike data. Temporary strike counts are kept in memory and are cleared when the cog unloads or the bot restarts.
